data.narrative:
Nordic Air Defence is a seed-stage defense and security company founded by Karl Rosander. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three same-sector, same- or adjacent-stage comparables: UFORCE (Seed, $1.0B), Singularity (Series A, $400M), and NODA AI (Series A, $125M). The broader comp universe spans 10 private companies and 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

The peer-median method, the applicable triangulation approach given available data, yields an implied valuation of $400M. This reflects the median across the three selected comparables, with a stated range of $125M to $1.0B. No revenue multiples, SaaS metrics, or exit-comparable analysis could be applied due to data constraints.

The triangulated valuation range is $340M to $460M, centered at $400M. This narrow band reflects reliance on a single method and a small peer cohort. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of UFORCE—a seed-stage outlier at $1.0B—and whether the Series A peers (Singularity, NODA AI) appropriately benchmark a seed company. The absence of revenue, funding amount, or growth metrics limits ability to stress-test comparables or identify stage-specific valuation drivers. Any refined valuation would require additional financial and operational data.
